patterns.failureBehavior: LLM_ERROR with a reason code; state unchanged.

fields.explanation: Stored for humans; never compared in consensus.
fields.name: digest

knownLimits: Cannot detect a consistently wrong verdict shared by every validator.
patterns.name: Verdict plus band

params.deterministic_checks: {'check_hard': True} | {'check_hard': False} | {'check_hard': True} | {'check_hard': True} | {'check_hard': True} | {'check_hard': True} | {'check_hard': False} | {'check_hard': True} | {'check_hard': True} | {'check_hard': True} | {'check_hard': True}

patterns.toleranceRationale: Models disagree on confidence more than on the decision; one band step absorbs that without allowing a decision flip.
patterns.useWhen: A judgment comes with confidence: eligibility, compliance, support.
patterns.whyNotStrictEq: One band step and id ordering vary honestly between validators; digest prose always differs.

patterns.failureBehavior: EXTERNAL with SOURCE_UNREACHABLE; downstream treats it as insufficient evidence, never a negative finding.
knownLimits: Does not verify that the page content is true.
patterns.name: Fact set
patterns.toleranceRationale: Counts and dates are bucketed; headings use normalized keys and a documented alias table.
patterns.useWhen: Extracting a fixed set of structured facts from a web page or API.
patterns.whyNotStrictEq: Page markup, heading case, counts and fetch order vary between validators.

patterns.failureBehavior: LLM_ERROR OUT_OF_RANGE or WRONG_TYPE; state unchanged.
knownLimits: A biased source that shifts every validator is not detected.
patterns.name: Bounded number

params.mode: bps | abs | bps | bps | bps | bps | bps | abs | bps | bps | bps | bps | abs | abs

patterns.toleranceRationale: Tolerance comes from observed variation and is recorded as integer basis points.
patterns.useWhen: A score, count, price or measurement has natural noise.
patterns.whyNotStrictEq: Independent measurement and model runs differ by small integer amounts.

patterns.failureBehavior: LLM_ERROR UNKNOWN_ID or TOPK_MISMATCH; state unchanged.

fields.explanation: normalize_ranked_id_list then topk_overlap(k, threshold, rank cap)
fields.name: ranking

invariants: every ranked id is in the candidate universe
knownLimits: A shared bias in candidate selection is invisible to the rule.
patterns.name: Ranking
patterns.toleranceRationale: Near-ties swap inside the top-k; the overlap threshold and rank cap are explicit integers.
patterns.whyNotStrictEq: Near-ties and tail order legitimately vary between model runs.

knownLimits: Aliases not listed in the domain's alias table count as different entities.
patterns.name: Entity set

params.mode: set_equal | overlap | overlap | set_equal | set_equal | overlap | set_equal | set_equal | set_equal | overlap | overlap | overlap | overlap | set_equal | set_equal

patterns.toleranceRationale: Casing, whitespace and duplicates are noise; the overlap threshold is an explicit integer percentage.
patterns.useWhen: Extracting entities, names or ids where order does not matter.
patterns.whyNotStrictEq: Order, casing and duplicates vary without changing the extracted set.

patterns.failureBehavior: EXTERNAL SOURCE_UNREACHABLE or LLM_ERROR; state unchanged.
invariants: UNAVAILABLE is never treated as false
knownLimits: Cannot detect a shared wrong belief about the world.
patterns.name: Boolean attestation

params.allow_unavailable: True | False | True | True | True | True

patterns.toleranceRationale: A boolean has no tolerance; only the source state may vary, and it is its own state.
patterns.useWhen: A single yes/no about the world, with evidence ids.
patterns.whyNotStrictEq: The source may be down for one validator; that is not a negative finding.
